text: Gen1: sampled Gaussians (p0005, 0.7220); exact-gradient L-BFGS-B on R over log-heights (p0006, 0.8197); least-squares fit of f so f*f approximates a flat-top trapezoid then direct-R polish (p0003, 0.8494, best of gen; beat hill-climbing p0002 0.7566, p0004 0.7421, p0007 0.7973). Flat-top target fitting was the strongest principle but only tested at N=300 with a coarse grid. Gen2: resampled p0003 to N=1500 and polished on R with p0006's exact analytic gradient plus noisy restarts: p0012 0.8629, confirming the basin was under-resolved at N=300. Superellipse targets (p0013, 0.8563) and Fourier-domain square-root projection imposing the target autoconvolution (p0011, 0.8563) tied but fell below p0012, so parametric/spectral targets accessed no better basin. Mutations p0008 0.8610, p0010 0.8592, p0009 (upscaling ladder to 32000) 0.8206. Best line: p0003's flat-top trapezoid target fit, resampled to N=1500, polished on R with p0006's exact gradient and restarts (p0012). Winning shape: max/mean ~7, autoconvolution max at ~0.34 of support, only ~5% of knots within 0.1% of max — broad asymmetric flat-top-ish, not a true rectangle. Gen3: resolution ladders, asymmetric seeding, flattening p0012's own f*f plateau. p0015 (progressive ladder 2000→16000 with log-noise restarts) 0.8642; p0018 (skewed seeds: exponential tilt ±0.3/±0.6, gamma resampling 0.8/0.85/1.18/1.25, exact-gradient polish, N=3000) 0.8661, new best; p0019 (flattened-target re-inversion) 0.8638. Wide-loop: p0017 0.8592, p0016 0.8363, p0014 0.8592. Gen4: p0022 (focused N sweep 2000–6000 from p0018) 0.8663, resolution alone nearly exhausted; p0024 (p0015 basin + p0018-style skew seeds at N=3000) 0.8664; p0025 (softmax-annealed max over near-max knots, tau 1e-2→1e-4, exact polish each stage) 0.8780, a large jump (+0.0119) with 28%/32%/33% of f*f knots within 0.1%/1%/5% of max and max at 0.569 of support. Wide-loop: p0020 0.8666, p0023 0.8604, p0021 0.8623. Best line: p0018's skew-seeded N=3000 basin refined by softmax annealing of the nonsmooth max (p0025, 0.8780). Open questions: how far softmax annealing plus higher N and better restart/noise schedules can push past 0.878; whether the annealed plateau can be combined with resolution ladders and richer target geometry rather than substituted; why f*f stays rippled/asymmetric despite flat-top objectives; whether a fundamentally different construction escapes this basin.
